subject: Offline T1 islands/hedges proofs ready; terraces missing second plan; runtime unchanged
body:
# C-08B: procedural certification evidence

## 2 October: three non-river T1 candidates complete, batch stopped

Changed files: `scripts/dev/certify-four-locks.mjs`, `scripts/dev/test-orchard-v2-certification.mjs`, `docs/expeditions/v2/certification/four-locks/diversity-audit.json`, this report and the three immutable directories claimed below. The CLI now saves request identity and full canonical fingerprints in each new result. Existing candidates/traces/results and the accepted river T1 reference were not regenerated or overwritten. Planner, core, App, gameplay rules, runtime entries and shared build remain untouched. No other-family work or paid service.

The authorised batch generated exactly one T1 seed1 candidate from each existing islands/hedges/terraces grammar. Six planner invocations total, two per candidate, each requesting8000 states, within the maximum three. The three-candidate batch is stopped; unused invocation allowance does not start another search.

| Archetype | Outcome | Certificate | Reported states per invocation | Canonical topology |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| islands | complete | `orchard-v2-2343002d9bd9767a` | 737,335 | `6f517b00380070b1` |
| hedges | complete | `orchard-v2-7a4ad8d2230e72c5` | 261,252 | `180e8d46b2621ee7` |
| terraces | unknown | none | 8031,986 | `772b36da02f2c5bf` |

Islands: actual two water cuts at offset columns4/7. Common target team Tuppence/Furrow/Sorrel wins directly in round4 on bridge+roots,27 commands, hash `7714830ad3f081ed`. Common Bushel/Dapple/Pip wins in round5 on bridge+shelter from the prepared alcove,30 commands, hash `1489b44dffb052ce`, winning Hold `dapple@r5#42`.

Hedges: actual hedge teeth at columns4/8 rows2/4/6, with a controlled gate and no water. The same two distinct Common teams win in round4 on bridge+roots and bridge+shelter,27/26 commands, hashes `cf3b4fdaf6d8eee5`/`3d0d1c6a544f945b`. The second win physically uses the prepared alcove, Hold `dapple@r4#37`.

Terraces: actual upper/lower hedge rows3/5 with permanent gaps and a controlled gate. Bushel/Dapple/Pip has a real round3 prepared-alcove win,21 commands, hash `3f532a351e9e1a7a`, Hold `dapple@r3#27`. Tuppence/Furrow/Sorrel's direct attempt exhausts8000 requested states; missing second distinct target-team and different target-output-plan proofs keep certification unknown. The physical alcove requirement is proved here. Unknown does not establish impossibility. Known Claude-owned R-07 reports8031, overage31, due to denied-spend accounting; the request and warning remain explicit in result metadata. No threshold, enemy, cost or planner change.

All three share canonical Sudoku pattern `3616a201ff801cd8`, exactly matching the river T1 pattern. Different map archetypes do not falsely add puzzle patterns. Full serializations are retained in each result and in the updated read-only audit. Canonical tile structures differ for all four actual grammars; tests check the raw water cuts and hedge rows/teeth, rather than accepting changed layout labels.

Evidence/trace paths:

- `docs/expeditions/v2/certification/four-locks/tier-1-islands-seed-1-archetypes-20261002/{candidate,traces,result}.json`
- `docs/expeditions/v2/certification/four-locks/tier-1-hedges-seed-1-archetypes-20261002/{candidate,traces,result}.json`
- `docs/expeditions/v2/certification/four-locks/tier-1-terraces-seed-1-archetypes-20261002/{candidate,traces,result}.json`
- Updated coverage: `docs/expeditions/v2/certification/four-locks/diversity-audit.json`.

Executable checks/invocations used:

```text
node scripts/dev/certify-four-locks.mjs --tier 1 --seed 1 --layout islands --max-states 8000 --evidence-id archetypes-20261002
node scripts/dev/certify-four-locks.mjs --tier 1 --seed 1 --layout hedges --max-states 8000 --evidence-id archetypes-20261002
node scripts/dev/certify-four-locks.mjs --tier 1 --seed 1 --layout terraces --max-states 8000 --evidence-id archetypes-20261002
node --test --test-reporter=dot scripts/dev/test-orchard-v2-certification.mjs expeditions/v2/generation/bank.test.js expeditions/v2/generation/runtime-generation.test.js
node scripts/dev/audit-four-locks-diversity.mjs
```

Outcome:19/19 targeted checks pass. Five new winning traces,131 accepted commands, replay independently through the real production reducer with all hashes and full certificate requirements checked. Audit independently reviews11 saved candidates and counts seven complete certificates. T1 now has three certified material entries: one each river/islands/hedges, still one puzzle pattern. Gaps:61 further material entries, seven further topologies in each of these three archetypes, eight certified terraces topologies and seven puzzle patterns. T2–5 retain their previous one river reference/one pattern and63-entry gaps. Actual runtime bank entries remain zero and runtime availability remains the existing certified river T1 reference only.

Ready dependency: reviewable T1 islands/hedges certificates and explicit terraces missing-proof evidence. Banks, QA-01, actual private App, other-family expansion and device/child tests remain unaccepted. No new screenshots for this offline certification batch. C-08B remains IN_PROGRESS; lock released after mailbox handoff.

2 October non-river T1 batch claims before editing: existing `scripts/dev/certify-four-locks.mjs`, `scripts/dev/audit-four-locks-diversity.mjs`, `scripts/dev/test-orchard-v2-certification.mjs`, the existing generated `diversity-audit.json`, this report and three new immutable directories `tier-1-{islands,hedges,terraces}-seed-1-archetypes-20261002/` under the owned certification root. One generated candidate per archetype, seed1,8000 states per invocation and at most three invocations each; stop after those three. Include canonical fingerprints with success/unknown evidence, including topology rejection details. Runtime/reference files, planner and core stay unchanged.

## 2 October: canonical fingerprints and read-only coverage audit

Changed files in this batch: new `expeditions/v2/generation/bank.js`, `bank.test.js`, `scripts/dev/audit-four-locks-diversity.mjs`, `docs/expeditions/v2/certification/four-locks/diversity-audit.json` and this report. No candidate generation or planner search, no previous candidate/trace/result modification, no runtime bank population and no shared rebuild. Existing production fingerprints/content hashes are preserved; these new canonicalisers are independent development audit tools.

Topology chooses the smallest sorted tile serialization across all12 axial D6 transforms and translation. It preserves terrain, cost, station/control/alcove/orchard/deployment roles, controlled/permanent passage flags and environmental hazard target/mutation roles. It drops artwork, decorative entity IDs and pressure numbers. Actual fixed engine station IDs resolve to semantic roles: an equivalent renamed station record must carry that same explicit `role`. IDs are not written into canonical records. Transformed/translated role positions follow the tiles; deployment order does not count as topology diversity.

Sudoku chooses the smallest variable/constraint-incidence serialization across all8 box-preserving row permutations, all8 column permutations and transpose. First-occurrence digit normalisation is the exact minimum across all24 digit bijections. It retains given positions/digit equality, typed sum-cage membership/linked markers and protection-group membership/effects. Shared cage incidence and shape relative to row/column/box units therefore remain inspectable. Numeric sums and solved numeric grids do not establish new dependency patterns and are omitted; this classifier is not puzzle truth, measured difficulty or tactical certification. Duplicate identical constraints and renamed/reordered IDs do not inflate pattern counts. Both full canonical serializations and hashes are published for inspection.

Executable checks:

```text
node --test --test-reporter=dot expeditions/v2/generation/bank.test.js scripts/dev/test-orchard-v2-certification.mjs expeditions/v2/generation/runtime-generation.test.js
node scripts/dev/audit-four-locks-diversity.mjs
```

Outcome:18/18 targeted tests pass. Adversaries cover all12 D6 forms with translation, tile order and renamed semantic entities; actual terrain/cost/anchor/passage/hazard changes differ. Sudoku covers every allowed row/column permutation, every digit bijection and combined transpose, renamed constraints, reordered cells and redundant constraints. Different givens, cage shape/overlap, linked markers and protection incidence differ. Eighty transformed equivalent copies still count as one material entry, one topology and one puzzle pattern. The first terrain-change test was a no-op on an already-floor tile; corrected the fixture to toggle terrain before the passing run. Existing certification and T1-only runtime replay checks pass.

The read-only audit independently re-certifies all8 saved candidates from their real production-reducer traces before counting. Five have complete matching certificates. Each tier has one certified material reference, one river topology and one puzzle dependency pattern. Three unknown candidates remain visible but do not count. Current certified structures, with full incidence in the audit:

| Tier | Certified parameter seed | Givens | Cage sizes | Shared cage pairs | Archetype |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | 1 | 6 | 2,2 | 1 | river |
| 2 | 1 | 3 | 2,2,2,2,2,2 | 1 | river |
| 3 | 2 | 3 | 2,2,2,2,2 | 2 | river |
| 4 | 0 | 1 | 2,3,3,3,3 | 2 | river |
| 5 | 29 | 0 | 2,3,3,3,3,3,3 | 5 | river |

Against the required evidence coverage at every tier:63 further distinct material entries, seven further river topologies, eight islands topologies, eight hedges topologies, eight terraces topologies and seven further puzzle patterns are missing. Actual registered runtime bank entries are zero: the counts above describe certified evidence available for review, not shipped64-entry banks. Only the existing T1 reference is runtime available. All banks remain incomplete, and the extra reference-fallback requirement must also be retained when a bank is populated.

Evidence/report path: `docs/expeditions/v2/certification/four-locks/diversity-audit.json`. It includes source directories, certificate/replay status, canonical serializations, readable constraint summaries, per-tier gaps and runtime reference availability. No screenshot was produced for this pure mathematical/topological audit.

Ready dependency: canonicalisers and coverage tooling are available for future accepted-bank review, without changing the frozen generator ABI. Remaining blockers are actual private App/QA-01, certified diversified banks, other-family dependency gates, device/child acceptance and Claude-owned R-07. Completed T4 search stays stopped. C-08B remains IN_PROGRESS; advisory lock released after publishing this handoff.

2 October canonical diversity batch exact claims, before editing: new `expeditions/v2/generation/bank.js`, `bank.test.js`, `scripts/dev/audit-four-locks-diversity.mjs`, `docs/expeditions/v2/certification/four-locks/diversity-audit.json` and this report. Read saved candidates/results/traces only; no candidate generation, planner call, runtime bank edit or original fingerprint/hash replacement. Canonical serializations accompany hashes so pattern incidence can be inspected. Audit per-tier against64 entries, four archetypes, eight distinct topologies per archetype and eight puzzle patterns.

## 2 October: bounded T4 follow-up complete, seed0 certified

This entry supersedes the earlier blanket T4 certificate-pending statement, while retaining the unknown seed1/29 outcomes. The authorised two-candidate follow-up is complete and stopped, with five planner invocations total. No cap escalation or further seed search.

Changed files: existing `scripts/dev/certify-four-locks.mjs`, `scripts/dev/test-orchard-v2-certification.mjs`, this report and the two immutable evidence directories claimed below. The CLI now accepts `--direct-team`, `--second-team` and `--alcove-team` as comma-separated production IDs. Explicit squads must have exactly three distinct actual cards, satisfy the relevant printed commissioning profile for their plan family and, for both T4 target plans and its fallback, remain within the target rarity band. Claude's existing planner handles deployment enumeration unchanged. Default example teams remain supported; no named card becomes mandatory.

T4 river seed0 is fully certified: `orchard-v2-82446cb7d436b578`. Warden/Gossamer/Harvestmoon wins directly in round3 on bridge+shelter, 20 commands, final hash `6bce05af4c24516c`. Ninebark/Warden/Longshadow wins in round3 on bridge+roots, 23 commands, final hash `00b5288baaf4d058`. The real winning endpoint is the prepared alcove with Warden's Hold `warden@r3#34`. All cards are actual target-band production cards. Both exact lower-band exclusions still pass. Planner reported106/477 states against8000 requested per invocation; fallback was not invoked.

T4 river seed29 remains unknown. Warden/Gossamer/Harvestmoon has a verified round3 direct win on bridge+shelter, 21 commands, final hash `0537c720e4d82745`. Ninebark/Warden/Longshadow's alcove attempt avoiding that output pair and Barrow/Harvestmoon/Longshadow's distinct fallback alcove attempt exhaust their8000 requested caps. Missing proof remains exactly: second distinct target-band team, different target output plan and actual winning-phase physical alcove. Failed bounded search is not an impossibility claim. The known R-07 denied-spend defect reports8006/8019, overages6/19, in retained result metadata; planner/core stay untouched.

Evidence/trace paths:

- `docs/expeditions/v2/certification/four-locks/tier-4-river-seed-0-followup-20261002/{candidate,traces,result}.json`
- `docs/expeditions/v2/certification/four-locks/tier-4-river-seed-29-followup-20261002/{candidate,traces,result}.json`

Executable invocations used:

```text
node scripts/dev/certify-four-locks.mjs --tier 4 --seed 0 --max-states 8000 --evidence-id followup-20261002 --direct-team warden,gossamer,harvestmoon --second-team ninebark,warden,longshadow --alcove-team barrow,harvestmoon,longshadow
node scripts/dev/certify-four-locks.mjs --tier 4 --seed 29 --max-states 8000 --evidence-id followup-20261002 --direct-team warden,gossamer,harvestmoon --second-team ninebark,warden,longshadow --alcove-team barrow,harvestmoon,longshadow
node --test --test-reporter=dot scripts/dev/test-orchard-v2-certification.mjs
```

Outcome:10/10 certification tests pass. The new test independently replays all three saved follow-up traces through the production reducer, re-evaluates certificates and lower-band exclusions, checks the saved squads, output distinction, actual alcove holder and explicit requested caps, and confirms T4 remains unavailable at runtime. Existing T1 and previous T2/T3/T5 proofs are preserved. Use a fresh evidence ID to rerun the CLI without overwriting results. No new screenshot, build output, deployment, paid service or other-family packet.

Ready dependency: scrum/Claude can review a real T4 production-reducer certificate, closing the individual mathematical-plus-tactical reference gap across T1–5. This does not complete any required procedural bank, diversity coverage or UI acceptance. Runtime remains certified T1 only; actual private App/QA-01, bank expansion, device/child testing and R-07 remain pending. C-08B remains IN_PROGRESS; advisory lock released after this handoff.

2 October T4 follow-up claim: same owned CLI/report/tests and new immutable evidence directories `tier-4-river-seed-0-followup-20261002/` and `tier-4-river-seed-29-followup-20261002/` under the existing claimed certification root. Two candidates only, 8000 requested states per invocation, at most three invocations each. Permit explicit genuine stat-feasible production squads in the CLI, without altering the planner. Preserve every certification requirement and R-07 accounting note; stop after this batch, regardless of outcome.

## 2 October: bounded T2–5 production-reducer evidence published

Changed files: `scripts/dev/certify-four-locks.mjs`, `scripts/dev/test-orchard-v2-certification.mjs`, this report and the four new evidence directories below. The CLI records requested limits, avoided output pairs and reported metric overage, and refuses to overwrite an existing result: use a fresh `--evidence-id` for another run. Planner, engine, App, runtime bank and accepted T1 evidence were not edited. No shared build was run.

Four candidate attempts, each capped at 8000 requested states per planner invocation and at most three invocations, are complete. Eleven planner invocations total; no open-ended brute force or cap increase. All nine returned winning traces independently replay through the production reducer with every command hash matching. Certificates preserve fixed production card stats, two distinct target-band teams with different output plans, paid Operate and an actual winning alcove endpoint. Exact lower-band squad/assignment enumeration excludes all below-target triples and one Legendary with two Commons in all four candidates.

| Tier / seed | Certification | Planner reported states by invocation | Evidence directory |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| T2 / 1 | success: `orchard-v2-0ffb784b641580f8` | 318, 251, 460 | `docs/expeditions/v2/certification/four-locks/tier-2-river-seed-1-bounded-20261002/` |
| T3 / 2 | success: `orchard-v2-892dcb83a818e5e4` | 599, 321, 452 | `docs/expeditions/v2/certification/four-locks/tier-3-river-seed-2-bounded-20261002/` |
| T4 / 1 | unknown; one verified direct win | 1844, 8002, 8024 | `docs/expeditions/v2/certification/four-locks/tier-4-river-seed-1-bounded-20261002/` |
| T5 / 29 | success: `orchard-v2-b839fe5ed87db2b9` | 7008, 5930 | `docs/expeditions/v2/certification/four-locks/tier-5-river-seed-29-bounded-20261002/` |

Each directory has `candidate.json`, `traces.json` and `result.json`. Traces contain immutable initial run, all accepted commands, per-command hashes, output choices and terminal hash. Result contains independent replay checks, actual winning holder/hold IDs, lower-band exclusions, planner metrics and requested caps. These are development certificates, not published runtime entries or completed diverse banks. No new screenshot: actual App route and QA-01 still await Claude integration.

Reproduction invocations used:

```text
node scripts/dev/certify-four-locks.mjs --tier 2 --seed 1 --max-states 8000 --evidence-id bounded-20261002
node scripts/dev/certify-four-locks.mjs --tier 3 --seed 2 --max-states 8000 --evidence-id bounded-20261002
node scripts/dev/certify-four-locks.mjs --tier 4 --seed 1 --max-states 8000 --evidence-id bounded-20261002
node scripts/dev/certify-four-locks.mjs --tier 5 --seed 29 --max-states 8000 --evidence-id bounded-20261002
node --test --test-reporter=dot scripts/dev/test-orchard-v2-certification.mjs
```

The recorded directories are now immutable to the CLI; rerun the first four with a new evidence ID. The verification command replays their saved evidence and passes 9/9 tests, including prior certification adversaries. All runtime availability checks still expose only T1.

T2 direct teams Cornix/Kernel/Beeswax and Cornix/Kernel/Millrace win rounds5/4 on bridge+shelter and bridge+roots; higher-band Cornix/Warden/Beeswax physically wins from the alcove in round3. T3 direct Barrow/Cobweb/Amberly and Barrow/Driftwood/Gable win rounds3/4 on those different plans; Barrow/Warden/Amberly physically wins from the alcove in round3. T5 target-band Warden/Gossamer/Harvestmoon wins directly in round4 on bridge+shelter; Ninebark/Warden/Longshadow physically wins from the alcove in round3 on bridge+roots. These nine traces total 218 accepted commands. Final hashes and holders are in the result files.

T4's Barrow/Cobweb/Harvestmoon direct trace wins round3 on bridge+storm, hash `031e1708ff88d553`. Both Warden/Longshadow/Cascade alcove invocations exhaust the cap: first avoids the direct bridge+storm output pair, second does not exclude an output pair. Missing second target-team/output-plan and physical-alcove evidence keep certification unknown. This is not proof that the mission or team is impossible.

Known unresolved R-07, unchanged and Claude-owned: `Budget.spend()` increments `used` before denying a spend, so the two exhausted invocations report 8002 and 8024 against requested caps of 8000. These figures are not accepted reducer-call counts or permission to exceed a cap. Requested and reported values, overages2/24 and the accounting warning are retained per attempt. No metric repair, enemy/cost/threshold weakening or unknown-to-unsatisfiable conversion was made.

Ready dependencies: C-08A/Claude and scrum can review real T2/T3/T5 production-reducer certificates and the bounded T4 partial trace. Still pending: T4 full certificate, bank diversity/coverage, private App playthrough/QA-01, device and child testing. Runtime stays the existing certified T1 reference; no other-family expansion. C-08B remains IN_PROGRESS and its advisory lock is released after this handoff.

Additional verification claim: existing `scripts/dev/test-orchard-v2-certification.mjs`, adding independent replay of the newly saved bounded batch and explicit continued T1-only runtime availability. No planner tests or planner source changes.

## First certified private reference

`node scripts/dev/certify-four-locks.mjs --tier 1 --seed 1 --max-states 40000` succeeded. Candidate, complete traces and hashes: `docs/expeditions/v2/certification/four-locks/tier-1-river-seed-1/`. Certificate `orchard-v2-7bb0c308bb8ec44f` is independently verified. Direct Tuppence/Furrow/Sorrel uses bridge+roots and wins round5; alcove Bushel/Dapple/Pip uses bridge+shelter and wins round4. All six cards are Commons. The first teaching-fixture reference attempt remains unknown; its evidence is retained separately. No complete bank is claimed.

`node --test scripts/dev/test-orchard-v2-certification.mjs`: 8 passed. R-06 addressed: verifyTrace captures the actual Shape endpoint/holder immediately before the winning End Round, after independently replaying every real command. A historical Prepare/Hold alcove followed by a direct final win is explicitly tested and does not count. This adversarial test uses a labelled engine-only fixture with real production stats, costs, enemy rules and station spacing, not a bank candidate. The genuine Dapple alcove win remains verified with its source Hold ID, and the certificate ID is unchanged. Invented profile stats, modified blueprints, duplicate proofs, deadline losses and hash edits are rejected. T2–5 lower-band and one-Legendary/two-Common exclusions use exact squad/assignment enumeration.

One planner boundary to review in Claude's owned file: the bounded reference attempt requested12000 states but reported12027 and12040. Do not allow a250000-state request to exceed the published hard cap; failure remains unknown.
